status: paper design c6, pending independent review and adoption. Each control is a specification; on adoption each would become an expectation row with runner null. 'kills' names the implementation mutation the control must detect (mutation-tested in principle); a residual control documents a limit and kills nothing. A paired control is two runs whose outcomes are compared. 'variant' tags a control with the variant of decision D-1 it tests (i, ii, both, or a paired run of both); a control tagged with an unadopted variant is dropped on adoption.

fixture: Fixture: the r9 fixture (a configuration K frozen at F citing reassessment A, repair Q superseding P, finding f) with custody constants PATH and BOOT in record_authority.py. V0 is the bootstrap version at BOOT with base B0. Unless stated, the run is op C execution at effective M with a cited discharge of A whose every other condition holds, K's freeze has not landed (K is not in R*(M), has no receipt and no freeze entry), every custody version that adds entries has an accepting non-author review of every added item, and every regular mode named is 100644 or 100755.

expected_vocabulary.outcome: PASS, FAIL, ERROR or ANY, as in the r9 controls
expected_vocabulary.item: the custody condition named in the record-invalid item (R6.CUST.9)
expected_vocabulary.invariants.not_class: classes or items that must not appear
expected_vocabulary.witness: the custody witness the result must report
